subject: maths
title: Introducing BIDMAS
welcome_lead: Maths has rules about which step comes first. BIDMAS keeps your answers correct every time.
meta_desc: Learn BIDMAS / BODMAS order of operations in this KS3 maths adventure.
final_note: Brilliant! BIDMAS is now your secret weapon.

walkthroughs.body_html: Brackets first, Indices (powers), then Division and Multiplication (left to right), finally Addition and Subtraction (left to right).
